explanation: William of Normandy defeated Harold at the Battle of Hastings in 1066, becoming William the Conqueror.

angles.e: William of Normandy defeated Harold at the Battle of Hastings in 1066, the last successful foreign invasion of England.

angles.q: Who led the Norman invasion of England?

angles.e: William of Normandy led the invasion, defeated Harold at Hastings in 1066, and became known as William the Conqueror.
